Turbo full-track decoding omits first-verse middle lines. Independent bounded small-model decoding recovers them and MMS aligns every supplied word.

pausePolicy: The long gaps before the final two words of each stanza are retained. No highlight runs through those pauses.
limits: ASR and source separation can miss or hallucinate speech. CTC boundaries are estimated; agreement is not independent human validation. No additional lexical passage was corroborated by the combined analysis.

longPauseCrossCheck.method: 2× time-compressed Whisper turbo on independently bounded endings; unforced MMS acoustic event decoding on original-speed vocals.
longPauseCrossCheck.result: Unforced original-speed acoustic events corroborate the final-word entries near 37.9, 87.6 and 137.2 seconds. Time-compressed Whisper confirms wording, but its boundaries absorb preceding pauses and are rejected as onset evidence. Residual stem energy alone does not establish an earlier lexical onset.
